from rest_framework_simplejwt.serializers import TokenObtainPairSerializer
from rest_framework_simplejwt.views import TokenObtainPairView
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from .models import ActiveSupportDelegationSession

class SupportAgentProxyTokenSerializer(TokenObtainPairSerializer):
    def validate(self, attrs):
        data = super().validate(attrs)
        target_client_id = self.initial_data.get('proxy_client_id')

        if target_client_id:
            if not ActiveSupportDelegationSession.objects.filter(
                client_id=target_client_id,
                assigned_agent=self.user,
                is_active=True
            ).exists():
                raise PermissionDenied("No active support delegation session found for this client")

            refresh = self.get_token(self.user)
            refresh['proxy_client_id'] = target_client_id
            refresh.access_token['proxy_client_id'] = target_client_id
            data['refresh'] = str(refresh)
            data['access'] = str(refresh.access_token)
        return data

class SupportAgentTokenView(TokenObtainPairView):
    serializer_class = SupportAgentProxyTokenSerializer
